# Q1. Mammals sleep dataset
```{r}
msleep |>
  filter(awake >= 12)
```
# Q2. Mutate msleep
```{r}
new_msleep <- msleep |> 
  mutate(
    percent_day_awake = (awake/24) * 100)

new_msleep |>
  select(percent_day_awake, awake, everything())
```
# Q3 Group_by y Summarise Storms
```{r}
storms |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(num_storms=n())
```
# Q4 filter and arrange storms
```{r}
windy_storms <- storms |>
  filter(wind > 50) 

windy_storms |>
  arrange(desc(wind))
```
# Q5 Which site and diameter has the highest total grahami in lizards
```{r}
lizards |>
  group_by(Site, Diameter) |>
  summarise(total_g = sum(grahami))|>
  arrange(desc(total_g))
```
# Q6 boxplot opalinus counts distribution under diff. light conditions
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=lizards,
       aes(x=opalinus, y=Site)) +
       geom_boxplot(aes(fill="hola"))
```
